title: Sri Lankan Lamb Curry for Kothu
description: Overnight-marinated lamb, browned hard then simmered in a roasted-spice, lemongrass and pandan gravy, finished with coconut milk.

ingredients.name: coconut oil, for the curry base

notes: Remove the cinnamon stick, lemongrass and pandan before chopping into kothu.
cook_notes: Try adding cumin seeds next time.
Fried shallots would make a good garnish.
